items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: different stars that I had worked for were in on that... Teresa Brewer

ctx.x: Oh, yes. We would be talking about that, be talking about the mid-'60s, I think. Through the … when did Ed Sullivan die, I forgot now. But at any rate, through his tenure at various times and various circumstances I would work for him. I remember the Carol Haney, I remember Lena Horne, Teresa Brewer … oh I remember that well because her big … union hurrah about that … different stars that I had worked for were in on that.
